label: GitHub account
description: Connect the GitHub account shared by pull requests, CI and issue sync.

label: App updates
description: Stay on the latest build. Downloads run in the background; restart when you are ready.

label: Update channel
description: Choose Stable releases or Beta pre-releases for auto-update.

label: Desktop app
description: System tray behavior and whether Minnow opens when you sign in.

label: Keep Minnow running after closing the window
Closing one of several windows
description: Whether closing one of several windows closes that workspace or leaves it running in the tray.

label: Interface zoom
description: Scale the Minnow desktop window (Electron shell only).

label: Hardware acceleration
description: Render the interface on the GPU. Turning it off frees the GPU for local models. Applies after a restart.

label: Notifications
description: Menubar bell when background chats, tasks, or jobs need attention.

label: Devices
description: Use Minnow from your phone or tablet, on your Wi-Fi or from anywhere.

label: Home network access
description: Let phones and tablets on your Wi-Fi connect to Minnow. Applies immediately.

label: Permissions
description: Manual, Auto or Full access — one level for every tool, command, website, MCP server and plugin.

label: Default project folder
description: Choose the default parent folder for new projects without moving existing projects.

label: Agent shell sandbox
description: Contain agent one-shot shells with OS filesystem sandboxing.

label: Backup and restore
description: Save chats, Brain, settings and credentials to one file, and restore them here or on another computer.

label: What a backup includes
description: Choose which parts of your data go into manual backups and scheduled snapshots.

label: Back up now
description: Write one backup file now, optionally encrypted with a passphrase.

label: Scheduled snapshots
description: Take a backup automatically every day or week and keep the newest few.

label: Restore from a backup
description: Bring a backup back. Current data is set aside, so a restore can be undone.

label: Run setup again
description: Re-open the first-run setup wizard.

label: Constrained tool calls
description: Validate tool arguments with JSON Schema when the provider supports structured output.

label: Installed plugins
description: Manage plugin packages and their contributions.

label: Add plugin
description: Review and install a plugin from a GitHub URL or a local folder.

label: Issue types
description: Customize issue type labels, ids, icons, and colors.

label: Issue statuses
description: Workflow statuses, board columns, and semantic roles.

label: Issue priorities
description: Priority levels for issues.

label: Goal evaluator
description: Model for /goal loop evaluation after each turn.

label: Utility tasks
description: One model for chat titles, prompt and issue expansion, and commit messages.

label: Local model guidance
description: Auto adds stricter tool rules for local providers; On or Off overrides it.

label: Orchestrator autopilot
description: Global defaults for orchestrate board concurrency, planner model, and retries.

label: Attempt time limit
description: Wall-clock cap for one board builder or tester attempt (default 240 minutes).

label: Watchdog
description: Idle and max-duration limits while streaming from the model. Sub-agent wall-clock lives under Sub-agents.

label: Generation timeouts
description: Idle and max-duration limits while streaming from the model. Idle timeout resets when new tokens arrive.

label: Sub-agent recovery
description: Crashed or timed-out sub-agents retry from the journal. Wall-clock budget is Sub-agents default/per-type timeout.

label: Self-heal & provisioning
description: Configure self-heal rounds, infra provisioning, and worktree cd-guard.

label: Require Flaticon interface icons
description: Tell agents to avoid emoji icons and use @flaticon/flaticon-uicons.

label: Limit tool result size
description: Caps how much text each file read, search, or shell command returns to the model. This does not compress chat history.

label: MCP hub
description: Connect other agents to Minnow’s Issues, Brain, and manual.

label: Skills Library
description: Browse curated third-party skill packs, install from GitHub, and manage provenance.

label: Use native browser for new agent tabs
Health and diagnostics
description: Subsystem probes, grouped errors, and a local log tail. Nothing is sent off-device.

label: File renderer errors to Issues
description: When enabled, uncaught renderer errors create bug cards in the Issues app (off by default).
